title: Housing: two neighbours and the refugee families
note: One invented town told in both tools. MORARG asks which influences carry reasons and which only push, and whether a plan could be justified to everyone affected. Moral Topology unveils the same events as factors that move two neighbours' points together; removing the false story leaves the points close but in a different octant. The model computes positions only; the plan they back is the story's stipulation. Factor labels and displacements are authored, neither tool's numbers are measurements, and nothing flows from a visitor's MORARG answers into Topology.

viewpoints.A: Pat: the town's first duty is to its own residents
viewpoints.B: Sam: the town owes the families help

events.event: A frightening crime story spreads and turns out to be false
The biggest employer closes, so there is really less money and housing
Residents meet the refugee families and hear what they fled
Sam meets residents who have waited two years for housing
events.morarg_reading: not in MORARG; added in Topology as the mirror encounter for the other neighbour

deployment_note: Deploy Topology 2.2 together with MORARG 5.2 or later. Public MORARG 0.5.1 has neither the town nor the deep links; Topology 2.2 works beside it, but its town case would then have no counterpart room.
